ios.desc:
Scan, create and style every code with QR8, the QR code reader and generator that puts a complete code toolkit in your pocket. Point the camera at any QR code or barcode and act on it instantly, or become a QR code maker and design your own custom codes with colors, shapes and your logo.

QR8 is a QR code scanner, barcode generator, business card creator and document scanner in one app. Read a code in a flash, then open the link, join the Wi-Fi, save the contact or call the number straight from the result.

Why choose QR8?

• Fast QR code reader and barcode scanner that opens links, joins Wi-Fi and saves contacts in one tap
• QR code generator for links, Wi-Fi, contacts, email, phone, SMS, locations, events and plain text
• Custom QR codes: colors, pixel and eye shapes, your logo or photo in the center, and social brand marks like Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
• Barcode maker for EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, ITF-14 and Codabar
• Digital business card with nine designs, shared as a vCard QR code
• Document scanner that turns paper into clean multi-page PDF files
• Live text capture: lift text and codes straight out of the camera view
• Export every code as PNG, PDF or crisp SVG vector and keep it in your library

Perfect for

• Restaurants and cafes that need a menu QR code on every table
• Small business owners printing QR codes on labels, posters, flyers and packaging
• Networking: share your contact details as a digital business card instead of paper
• Sharing your Wi-Fi password with guests without spelling it out
• Weddings, invitations and events - one scan takes guests to everything
• Anyone who scans QR codes and barcodes every day and wants a fast, clean reader

How it works

• Open the scanner and point at any QR code or barcode - the result is ready to act on
• Or pick a code type, enter your link, text or contact, and generate your QR code
• Style it: colors, shapes, logo - then export as PNG, PDF or SVG
• Build your business card once and share it anywhere as a QR vCard

Tools

• Scan - QR code and barcode reader with instant actions
• Create - QR code generator and barcode maker
• Business Card - your digital vCard as a QR code
• Documents - scan paper to PDF, reorder pages and mark them up
• Created - every code, card and document you have made, in one library

QR8 combines a QR code reader, QR code creator, barcode generator, vCard business card and PDF document scanner so you never need five separate apps. No ads

quotes.text:
Hello HN community!

I’m Tunahan, and I’m excited to share QReator, my 3rd iOS app! I created QReator to simplify how we interact with QR codes and barcodes. Whether you need to scan, create, or organize, QReator is built to handle it all seamlessly.

What does QReator do?

Scan Quickly and Accurately: Uses Apple's native scanning tech for fast results across QR codes, barcodes, and more.

Customizable QR Code Generator: Create unique QR codes for business, personal use, or marketing—complete with logos and custom designs.

Barcode Generator: Generate 10+ types of barcodes for inventory, product tracking, and more.

Document Scanner and Organizer: Scan, save, and share documents as PDFs.

Digital Business Cards: Create and share personalized e-cards with your contact details and social media.

The app is free to use, with premium features available if you need more advanced customization and organizational tools.

Why QReator?
I wanted to build an intuitive app that combines utility and creativity for anyone working with QR codes or barcodes—be it entrepreneurs, students, or casual users.

Looking forward to your feedback!
This is my second submission here, and I’d love to hear your thoughts, suggestions, or critiques. I’m eager to make QReator better for everyone!

Thank you for your time and feedback—it means the world to me!

Best,
Tunahan
